info.title: PeckList API
info.description: The HTTP API of a PeckList server. Sign in with an API key from Settings > API keys (Authorize, then the key as it was shown: pl_...). In a browser signed in to this server, the session works too. For tasks, lists, sections and tags use the task API under /api/v1: plain JSON, versioned, errors as problem+json with a stable code. POST /api/sync is the apps' internal sync protocol and changes with them.

get.summary: What this server is: its version, data schema, time zone, file size limit, and whether sign-in and demo mode are on

post.summary: Internal: the apps' sync
post.description:
The protocol the PeckList apps sync with: whole entities with per-field clocks. It is internal and changes with the apps; scripts and other tools use the task API under /api/v1, which is versioned.

An API key needs the tasks:read scope.

get.summary: Tasks, filtered, a page at a time (next is the cursor for the following page)
get.description: An API key needs the tasks:read scope.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: In this list; repeat it, or separate ids with commas, for any of several

parameters.name: sectionId
parameters.description: In this section

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Subtasks of this task; none for top-level tasks only

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: open (the default), done, wontdo or all

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: With this tag or one under it (home matches home/yard); repeat it for any of several

parameters.name: dueBefore
parameters.description: Due on or before this date (2026-11-30)

parameters.name: dueAfter
parameters.description: Due on or after this date

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: true for deleted tasks instead of live ones

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: With this priority: none, low, medium or high (or 0 to 3); repeat it, or use commas, for any of several

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Assigned to me (to you, or a group you are in), none (to nobody), or user:<id> or group:<id> (see /api/v1/people)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words that must all be in the title or notes, any case (at most 200 characters and 8 different words)

parameters.name: idSuffix
parameters.description: The id ends with this: 4 to 26 letters and digits, any case

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Tasks per page, 1 to 500 (100 by default)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next of the page before
